# Feature Backlog

This document lists features and enhancements derived from the plan. It is a living document that will evolve throughout the project. It is grouped by version, with the Backlog tracking all features not added to a version yet. It is used to create versions to work on.

| Status |  | Priority |  |
|--------|-------------|---------|-------------|
| 🔴 | Not Started | High | High priority items |
| 🟡 | In Progress | Medium | Medium priority items |
| 🟢 | Completed | Low | Low priority items |

## v1.2.0 - 🟢 Completed
Document the new **Best Practices** functionality added in Cody Product Builder **v2.2.0**. Best Practices is a project-level concept: a `best-practices/` folder (alongside `plan/` and `build/`) holding `project-best-practices.md` — the project's living, categorized record of build learnings. It is created empty at project setup (or lazily on first build/refresh for older projects), **written** after every version or patch build (captured from the retrospective/patch plus the session), and **read** when generating a design, starting a patch, during implementation, and on `:cody refresh`. Kept lean: contradicted rules are changed or removed, not appended. This is a content-and-metadata update to the already-published Cody Product Builder skill docs (not a new skill) — one new Reference page plus a consistency pass across the pages the feature touches, the skill version bumped `2.1.0` → `2.2.0`, and a changelog entry. Drafted from the real skill source at `~/.claude/skills/cody-product-builder/` (`references/best-practices-capture.md`, `references/best-practices-consult.md`, `references/phases.md`, `assets/best-practices/project-best-practices.md`).

| ID    | Feature                       | Description                              | Priority | Status |
|-------|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------|----------|--------|
| 1.2.1 | Version bump + sidebar entry  | In `src/skills/cody-product-builder/skill.ts`, change `version: '2.1.0'` → `'2.2.0'` (drives the VersionBadge and the landing-page card automatically), and add `{ label: 'Best Practices', slug: 'reference/best-practices' }` to the **Reference** sidebar group (after Prototypes). | High | 🟢 Completed |
| 1.2.2 | New Reference page — Best Practices | Create `src/skills/cody-product-builder/reference/best-practices.md`, a conceptual reference mirroring `prototypes.md`.
